discoveryPlan.note: Published accounts must never be rediscovered as GENUINELY_NET_NEW. HOLD continuation and justified refresh take queue priority over raw discovery.

publication.note: Preview mode does not publish. Re-run Mode FullE2E with -AuthorizePublication to publish.
